CustomField.description: Admin triage disposition for a step failure that has NO Finding — a tester can fail a step without filing one, and those failures need a queue too. When a Finding exists for this step (Source__c = 'Test case', Test_Step_Result__c populated), the Finding's Workflow_Status__c is the defect's record; this field does not replace it. Written only by UatReportController.setStepWorkflowStatus behind the UAT_Console gate; UAT_Tester holds it read-only, and UatRunController.saveStepResult never touches it. Values mirror Exploratory_Finding__c.Workflow_Status__c, UatReportController.WORKFLOW_STATUS_VALUES and lwc/uatConstants WORKFLOW_STATUSES — change all together.
CustomField.label: Workflow Status
